description: Which Uniswap v4 pools does this launchpad token's venue policy forbid? Get one launchpad v2 token's URC-5 (Token Venue Policy) record on Robinhood Chain: its live mode (enforced or preferred), its official ("canonical") pools, and every Uniswap v4 pool that holds it. Each pool is marked canonical or off_list, with allowed_by_policy and in-range liquidity (the liquidity active at the current price, not total deposits). Enforced means routers that follow URC-5 must not use other v4 pools. Preferred means official pools are recommended and others are allowed. Before graduation a token lists no official pool, so an enforced token allows no v4 pool yet. launch.creator_venue_choice is what the creator picked at launch. It is not the live mode. Also returns policy history and a summary. An unknown token, including launchpad v1 launches and STANDARD itself, returns 404. If the data is too old the route answers 503 withheld instead of guessing. Values are the last snapshot reads at the block numbers shown, not live reads.
